pretreatment: solvent cleaning, etching in NH3OH solution, degassing at 275°C
evidence: The substrate was prepared by solvent cleaning, followed by etching in NH3OH solution, and was set on a molybdenum holder with an indium contact. After degassing the substrate in a loading chamber, it was transferred to the first chamber where a GaAs buffer layer of 1000 A in thickness was grown on the substrate in a conventional manner.
